environment.description: Container deployed on Kubernetes with a restricted PodSecurityPolicy. The pod spec includes securityContext with drop: [ALL] and add: [CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE] only. Additionally, a Cilium NetworkPolicy enforces L7 HTTP filtering that restricts POST requests to /migrate/* paths to only originate from pods with label 'app.kubernetes.io/component=migration-worker' within the same namespace. The container runs with readOnlyRootFilesystem: true and runAsNonRoot: true (uid 1000). Capabilities CAP_NET_RAW and CAP_SYS_ADMIN are explicitly dropped. The Cilium L7 policy uses HTTP-aware filtering with method matching and header inspection requiring X-Internal-Caller: migration-controller header on all POST /migrate/* requests.
